requirement.description: The Flask hook is not properly detecting and instrumenting Flask applications created in test modules. The hook_flask function attempts to detect Flask apps but fails to correctly identify test-created Flask apps because they are not passed via the initiators parameter and are not detected in sys.modules.
requirement.contract: The hook_flask function must properly detect and instrument Flask applications created in test modules, particularly when Flask apps are created dynamically within test contexts (e.g., in create_app functions) and are not passed as initiators. It should ensure that all view functions and error handlers associated with detected Flask apps are properly hooked for HTTP recording.

requirement.description: The generic hook mechanism doesn't properly handle Flask app detection in test environments where Flask apps are created dynamically. The current implementation fails to recognize Flask apps that are created within test modules rather than being imported or passed as initiators.
requirement.contract: The hook_generic function should enhance its Flask app detection capabilities to identify Flask applications created dynamically within test modules. It must be able to detect Flask apps by scanning module attributes and recognizing Flask-specific patterns even when the apps aren't explicitly passed as initiators.
